coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in title, conditions or inclusion criteria; only 'recurrent HGG' (description mentions 'WHO grade III and IV', which does not count under C7) -> high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Registered EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0) - S3 by [CODE]. Each azole is the sole investigational agent in its own arms -> experimental_monotherapy. Other tissue endpoints (Ki-67, TUNEL, VEGF/CD-31 IHC, glycolytic metabolites) are histological/pharmacodynamic readouts, not recorded as molecular biomarkers.
